scripts.contracts:generate: dotnet build services/api/Xinobi.Api.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore && pnpm contracts:generate:typescript && pnpm contracts:generate:dart
scripts.contracts:generate:dart: openapi-generator-cli generate -i packages/contracts/openapi/v1.json -g dart-dio -o packages/clients/dart -t tools/openapi-templates/dart --global-property=apiTests=false,modelTests=false --additional-properties=pubName=xinobi_api_client,pubVersion=0.1.0,pubPublishTo=none,pubLibrary=xinobi_api_client,serializationLibrary=built_value
scripts.contracts:check: pnpm contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- packages)"
